answers.bix-6-q1: Acute Tcells showed the strongest evidence of pathway enrichment when combining replicates using the minimum p-value in the over-representation analysis.
answers.bix-6-q3: Twelve pathways remain significantly enriched (adjusted p-value < 0.05) across all three rounds of chronic T cell exposure.
answers.bix-6-q4: The Spearman correlation coefficient between replicates for chronic round 1 genes is approximately 0.021.
answers.bix-6-q5: Approximately 63% of screening conditions (excluding the no T cells control) showed significant enrichment of immune-relevant pathways.
answers.bix-6-q6: The Spearman correlation coefficient between replicates S1 and S2 for the acute T cell screen MAGeCK p-values is approximately 0.022.
answers.bix-6-q7: In chronic screen round 2, the most significantly enriched pathway is “Cytokine Signaling in Immune system.”
